document_texts.text:
Alex Rahman
alex.rahman@example.com · +880 1711 555 210 · github.com/alexr · linkedin.com/in/alexrahman

Backend engineer with eight years of experience building reliable services in Rust, Go and Python, most recently leading the routing platform at a logistics company.

Experience

Senior Software Engineer, Northwind Logistics, Dhaka, Bangladesh (2021 – present)
- Led the migration of 12 backend services from Python to Rust.
- Cut p99 latency of the routing API from 480 ms to 95 ms.
- Mentored four junior engineers through their first production launches.
- Designed the event pipe-
line that processes shipment updates.
- Ran the on-call rotation for the routing team and wrote the runbooks that new engineers still start from.
- Introduced structured logging and distributed tracing across the routing services, so most incidents can now be diagnosed from a single dashboard.
- Worked with product managers to scope the multi-depot routing project and delivered it across two quarters.
- Built a capacity model for the routing cluster that the infrastructure team now uses for quarterly budgeting.
- Wrote the internal guide to building Rust services at Northwind, covering error handling, testing and observability.

Backend Engineer, Brightline Health, Remote (2018 – 2021)
- Built the appointment scheduling service used by 40 clinics.
- Maintained the Postgres schema and wrote its migration tooling.
- Introduced property-based tests to the billing module.
- Moved the scheduling service from a single virtual machine to Kubernetes, with zero-downtime deploys.
- Built the audit log the compliance team uses to review who accessed patient records and when.
- Led the move from nightly batch exports to a streaming integration with three partner clinic systems.

Junior Developer, Kite Analytics, Chattogram, Bangladesh (2016 – 2018)
- Wrote the nightly ETL jobs that loaded customer usage data into the reporting warehouse.
- Replaced a hand-maintained spreadsheet of client reports with a self-service dashboard used by the sales team.
- Fixed and documented the deploy scripts, cutting a typical release from half a day to under an hour.

Software Engineering Intern, Meghna Telecom, Dhaka, Bangladesh (2015)
- Built an internal tool for tracking SIM card stock across regional warehouses.
- Wrote unit tests for the billing reconciliation scripts and fixed the bugs they found.

Projects

tracewire (Rust, Tokio, OpenTelemetry; 2022 – present)
- An open-source Rust crate for propagating trace context across async tasks, with about 900 GitHub stars.
- Maintain the crate, review contributions from other companies and publish its releases.

Shipment simulator (Rust, Kafka; 2023)
- A load-testing tool that replays a day of real shipment events against the staging environment.
- Found two capacity bottlenecks in the routing API before the 2023 peak season.

Talks
- Tracing async Rust in production, RustConf 2024.
- Moving a Python monolith to Rust one service at a time, Rust Dhaka meetup 2023.

Education

B.Sc. Computer Science, University of Dhaka, Dhaka, Bangladesh (2014 – 2018)

Skills
Languages: Rust, Go, Python, SQL
Infrastructure: PostgreSQL, Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker
Tools: Git, Grafana, Terraform, OpenTelemetry

Alex Rahman
Senior Software Engineer at Northwind Logistics · Dhaka, Bangladesh

About
I like boring, reliable backend systems and the tooling that keeps them that way.

Experience

Northwind Logistics

Organizer, Code Fest 2019, University of Dhaka Programming Club

Found sponsors who covered the whole budget.

job_descriptions.text: We're looking for a senior engineer to own our Rust services, mentor the team and improve reliability.
Build and operate the services that move money for thousands of small businesses.
Lead the technical direction of our routing platform: reliability, observability and the next generation of route planning.
Write and maintain the Rust services behind our port logistics platform.
Own the services that pay out sellers on time, every time.
Build the tracing and metrics platform hundreds of engineers rely on.
Lead backend work on our energy-trading platform.
Run the infrastructure behind our machine-learning research.
Help us build the internal platform our product teams deploy on.
